properties.name: auth.jwt.secret
properties.description: Base64-encoded HMAC-SHA256 signing secret. Min 32 characters. Use environment variables in production.

properties.name: auth.jwt.expiration
properties.description: Token validity in milliseconds. Default: 86400000 (24 hours).

properties.name: auth.jwt.token-prefix
properties.description: Prefix before JWT in Authorization header. Default: Bearer

properties.name: auth.jwt.header-name
properties.description: HTTP header name containing the JWT token. Default: Authorization

properties.name: auth.jwt.public-endpoints
properties.description: Ant-style URL patterns that bypass JWT authentication.
